run_sample_images: run the sample.py CLI to generate fake images from a BigGAN or StyleGAN2 model using a JSON config
run_tester_class: run the Tester class to load a GAN model and sample images in batch mode
review_tester_call: review the Tester __call__ method that loads models, samples images, and saves them to disk
refactor_tester_call: refactor the Tester __call__ method to fix the bare config variable references that should use self.config
summarize_sample_cli: summarize the sample.py CLI entry point that parses args, loads JSON config, and runs the Tester
